verdict.rationale: Typesense is API-first: the complete API surface ships in the open-source server (docs-56), Cloud plans list 'Full API Access' alongside the visual dashboard (docs-54), and community users describe it as a REST interface over a Lucene-like feature set (comm-2). Cloud-side management (creating and configuring clusters, building collections, indexing, tuning search, reading metrics) is also exposed programmatically through the official MCP server (docs-43, docs-53). Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement that every Cloud dashboard action has an API equivalent, a published OpenAPI spec (website probe paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
